description: Unit tests for the TimePurgePredicate class, validating its purge logic based on message age and cache duration.

classes.name: TimePurgePredicateTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the TimePurgePredicate class's purging behavior.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that no purge occurs when message age and cache time are below thresholds.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_PurgeDataThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that purge occurs when message age and cache time exceed thresholds.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeAgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Ensures no purge when message has been in cache long enough but is not old enough.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeTimeInCacheThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Ensures no purge when message is old enough but hasn't been in cache long enough.
